programs.title: The Sea’s Fruits Ep.2
programs.desc: With 18,000 kilometers of coastline, China boasts a wide range of ecosystems and a rich source of marine ingredients. The Sea's Fruits focuses on these small treasures of the sea—how they are caught, cooked, and shared. Told through stories of coming together and saying goodbye, the documentary celebrates the joy of eating and explores people's perspectives on family, friendship, and the natural world.

programs.title: Aerial China III Ep.1
programs.desc: Yunnan straddles the Hengduan Mountains and Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, revealing Kawagarbo Peak, vibrant Lijiang, and Hani's golden terraces. Come fly with us on a quest for the essence of Yunnan and discover why it so richly deserves its name - Yunnan, 'the Land South of the Clouds'!

programs.title: Relishing Life
programs.desc: It's said that amid the hustle and bustle of the world we should occasionally spare a moment to look up at the moon. But it's possible to find the moon also in old books and artifacts. Yuan Hongqi has been researching the history of the Qing Dynasty's imperial court and its cultural artifacts at the Palace Museum for 47 years. Throughout history, the moon has risen and set on countless occasions, shining on mountains, illuminating rivers and lighting up the way ahead for everyone, from emperors and ministers, to common people. So, let's listen to Yuan's stories about how the Mid-Autumn Festival was celebrated at the imperial court all those centuries ago.

programs.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programs.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programs.title: Foodwise: How to Order Chinese Food
programs.desc: How do you order Chinese food? What's the best way to pair dishes? And what's up with the naming system? In this episode, hosts Tianran and Eva will give you a crash course on everything from deciphering the menu and choosing the right restaurant, to pairing dishes according to color, aroma, taste, and form, so that by the end of the show, you too can feast your friends like a pro.

programs.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programs.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programs.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.5
programs.desc: In this final episode, Tianran journeys to Nyingchi, known as “Xizang’s Garden.” Here, he experiences the region’s semi-pastoral way of life — feeding yaks, trying his hand at archery, and seeing how tourism is transforming lives in Lulang International Tourist Town. Travelling along National Highway 318, Tianran discovers towering millennia-old cypress trees and rafts through the vast Yani National Wetland Park, before ending the day with a unique spa treatment at a traditional Tibetan hospital.

programs.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programs.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programs.title: Sweet Planet Ep.3
programs.desc: From China to France, America to India, and beyond - throughout human history, confectionery and desserts have united the world's shared sweet tooth, bringing hope and connection.

programs.title: A Bite of Dongguan Ep.3
programs.desc: An exploration of authentic urban cuisine, this documentary unveils the hidden culinary world beneath the surface of Dongguan - an international city with a deeply rooted food culture.

programs.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programs.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programs.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programs.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programs.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programs.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programs.title: China Bound: Xiamen
programs.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programs.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programs.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

Our Common Homeland Ep.1
programs.desc: Our Common Homeland presents real-life examples of China putting international biodiversity conventions into practice and building an ecological civilization. The film highlights the rapid progress China has made in biodiversity conservation over recent years, and showcases China's environmental contributions to the planet.

programs.title: Aerial China III Ep.2
programs.desc: Anhui, located in eastern China, spans the North-South divide, carved by the Yangtze and Huaihe Rivers. While Huangshan dominates the southern highlands, Hefei anchors the center and the northern plains play their role as China's breadbasket.

programs.title: Voyage to the Moon
programs.desc: For thousands of years, people have been fascinated by the night sky. Through their observations, reflections and questions concerning the origins of the moon and stars, they have sought to understand the nature of the eternal struggle between finite life and the vastness of the universe. The knowledge that life has its limits while knowledge knows no bounds is inherent in the Chinese nation. Bai Jikai is a senior photojournalist with Beijing Daily, who has focused on filming the night sky for the past 30 years. He believes that it is always possible to break through the limitations of time and space and transcend the obstacle of distance, and that this allows us to perceive the eternal and unchanging nature of the universe.
